austria/vienna-old-town.name: Vienna Innere Stadt and the Ringstrasse
austria/vienna-old-town.description: The old centre around St. Stephen Cathedral, the Hofburg and the grand ring boulevard.
austria/vienna-old-town.details: The inner city is compact and walkable. St. Stephen Cathedral has a tower with views and a glittering roof, the Hofburg palace complex holds the imperial apartments, and the Ringstrasse circles the centre with the opera house, parliament and museums. A tram ride along the Ring is a cheap overview.

austria/schonbrunn.name: Schonbrunn Palace and gardens
austria/schonbrunn.description: The Habsburg summer palace with gilded rooms, a maze and a hilltop Gloriette.
austria/schonbrunn.details: Schonbrunn has over a thousand rooms, of which about forty are open on tours, including the Hall of Mirrors. The gardens are free to walk and climb to the Gloriette for a view over Vienna. Buy timed tickets ahead in summer, and go early to avoid crowds.

austria/belvedere.name: Belvedere and Klimt
austria/belvedere.description: Baroque palaces housing Austrian art, including Klimt The Kiss.
austria/belvedere.details: The Upper Belvedere has the world largest Klimt collection, including The Kiss, plus works by Schiele and Kokoschka. The gardens between the two palaces are lovely for a stroll. Allow two hours, and book a timed entry in busy periods.

austria/vienna-coffeehouse.name: Viennese coffee house and Naschmarkt
austria/vienna-coffeehouse.description: A slow coffee and cake in a historic cafe, plus the long food market on the Wienzeile.
austria/vienna-coffeehouse.details: Viennese coffee house culture is listed by UNESCO. Sit with a melange and a slice of Sachertorte or apple strudel for as long as you like. The nearby Naschmarkt has stalls and restaurants, busiest on Saturdays with a flea market behind it.

austria/vienna-opera-concert.name: Vienna State Opera or classical concert
austria/vienna-opera-concert.description: An evening of music in the city of Mozart and Strauss.
austria/vienna-opera-concert.details: Vienna offers opera at the State Opera and concerts in the Musikverein and smaller halls, many with palace settings. Standing tickets at the Opera are available on the day and are cheap. Dress smartly. Book ahead for popular dates.

austria/wachau-valley.name: Wachau Valley and Melk Abbey
austria/wachau-valley.description: Danube vineyards and apricot orchards, a baroque abbey and the ruined castle at Durnstein.
austria/wachau-valley.details: The Wachau is a World Heritage landscape along the Danube west of Vienna. Melk Abbey is a baroque monastery with a library and church, and Durnstein is a village of pastel buildings below a castle ruin. A river cruise or cycle ride along the Danube path is the best way to see it. Apricots are in season in July.

austria/salzburg-old-town.name: Salzburg old town and Mozart
austria/salzburg-old-town.description: A baroque old town of squares and churches on the Salzach, the birthplace of Mozart.
austria/salzburg-old-town.details: Salzburg altstadt is a UNESCO site, with Getreidegasse, the cathedral, Residenzplatz and Mozart Geburtshaus. It is compact and walkable, with Mirabell Gardens across the river featured in The Sound of Music. A day of wandering with coffee stops suits it well.

image.author: Leonhard Lenz

austria/hohensalzburg.name: Hohensalzburg Fortress
austria/hohensalzburg.description: A medieval fortress on a hill above Salzburg, reached by funicular or on foot.
austria/hohensalzburg.details: The fortress is one of the largest medieval castles in Europe, with a museum, state rooms and views over the town and Alps. A funicular climbs from the old town, and a footpath is possible for those who want exercise. Evening concerts are held in the fortress hall.

austria/sound-of-music-tour.name: Sound of Music locations and lake district
austria/sound-of-music-tour.description: Film sites around Salzburg and the Salzkammergut lakes, usually by minibus.
austria/sound-of-music-tour.details: Tours visit the Mirabell Gardens, Leopoldskron palace, the basilica at Mondsee and the lake district scenery used in the film. Fans enjoy the singalong. Tours last about four hours. Independent travellers can do a similar loop by bus.

image.title: File:Mary Martin in The Sound of Music by Toni Frissell.jpg
image.author: Toni Frissell / Adam Cuerden

austria/hallstatt.name: Hallstatt village and lake
austria/hallstatt.description: A postcard village of timber houses on a mountain lake, a UNESCO site.
austria/hallstatt.details: Hallstatt sits between the Hallstatter See and steep mountains, with a small square, an old chapel with its Beinhaus, and lake views. It is very busy by day with tour groups, so stay overnight to enjoy the evening and early morning calm. Boat trips cross the lake, and a cable car climbs to the Skywalk.

austria/hallstatt-salt-mine.name: Hallstatt salt mine and Skywalk
austria/hallstatt-salt-mine.description: The world oldest salt mine, reached by funicular, with a miners slide and a mountain viewing platform.
austria/hallstatt-salt-mine.details: The salt mine above Hallstatt has been worked for thousands of years. Visitors ride a funicular, put on miners overalls and slide down wooden chutes. The Skywalk platform gives views over the village and lake. Tours need booking in summer.

austria/dachstein.name: Dachstein Five Fingers and Ice Cave
austria/dachstein.description: A cable-car trip to a glacier plateau with a platform and an ice cave.
austria/dachstein.details: The Dachstein cable car from Obertraun rises to a plateau with the Five Fingers viewing platform and the Giant Ice Cave. Weather changes fast, and it is cold at the top even in summer, so bring warm clothes. Check the webcam before going.

austria/innsbruck-old-town.name: Innsbruck old town and Golden Roof
austria/innsbruck-old-town.description: An alpine city with a medieval centre, a golden balcony and mountains at the end of every street.
austria/innsbruck-old-town.details: Innsbruck is a compact town in the valley of the Inn, with the Golden Roof, the Hofburg and the cathedral all within a short walk. The old town is arcaded and lively. Nordkette is a short ride away. The city is a good base for the Tyrolean Alps.

austria/nordkette.name: Nordkette cable car
austria/nordkette.description: A cable car from the centre of Innsbruck to alpine peaks at 2,300 metres.
austria/nordkette.details: The Nordkettenbahn climbs from the old town to the Hafelekar summit in about twenty minutes, with views across the Inn valley and Karwendel range. Trails lead along the ridge, and the architecture of the stations was designed by Zaha Hadid. It is a good half-day in clear weather.

austria/swarovski-wattens.name: Swarovski Crystal Worlds
austria/swarovski-wattens.description: A crystal-themed art space in Wattens, a short ride from Innsbruck.
austria/swarovski-wattens.details: Swarovski Kristallwelten is an art and exhibition complex entered through the mouth of a giant, with underground chambers of crystal. It suits a wet day. Buses run from Innsbruck, and a visit takes about two hours.
